records.subject: A quick nudge about your Wrenfield workspace
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

A lot of teams stall right at inviting their first teammate. If that's where things got stuck, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: A few days into Wrenfield -- how's it going?
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Checking in on how Bright Dynamics is settling into Wrenfield. If anything feels clunky or confusing, I'd genuinely like to hear about it.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Bright Dynamics set up
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Your workspace for Bright Dynamics is ready to go. The single highest-leverage thing in week one is creating a real project rather than a test one -- it's what makes the first week actually useful.

I'm here if anything's unclear.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

draft.subject: Getting Bright Dynamics' first project started
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Following up after our kickoff last week. It looks like Bright Dynamics hasn't started a first project yet, and I don't want that to be the thing that slows the team down.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through it with you and answer anything that came up since kickoff.

Best,
Chidi
